answer: Proposal: no carryover -- re-verify every identity each epoch. From the epoch seed each key draws a lotus: a random mix of RAM footprint, sequential compute and streamed responses. Deadlines coincide inside one short window and mixes differ per key, so a box cannot time-share; a vine of clones on one host passes only what its hardware runs at once. New keys must add real inventory -- linear cost, no bulk discount; farms lose while per-epoch reward stays below one passing unit's rental. An idle relic proves nothing. Limit: colluding verifiers can fake readings; rotation shrinks that trust.
